en: A colorized historical postcard showing a lively open‑air market in a European town square. Vendors, mostly women in long dresses and shawls, sell vegetables and other goods from carts and baskets. In the center stands a tall statue on an ornate pedestal in front of multi‑story buildings with shuttered windows and arched ground‑floor openings. A clock or bell tower with crenellations rises in the background. At the bottom of the image is an Italian caption identifying the place.
